thread:
Carmen (ML Eng): quick sync — Mistral-9p onboard update. We pushed int8 quant to canary yesterday and saw a reproducible quality dip on long summarization prompts (~8-12% drop on ROUGE-L for that slice). Cost looks great (roughly 2.6–3x token-cost reduction). need hypotheses + ops plan.

Ravi (Eval): numbers: canonical summarization slice (N=1k): fp16 mean ROUGE-L=0.617, int8 mean ROUGE-L=0.568, delta -0.049 (~7.9% relative). latency median down 28%, p95 down 34%.

Ravi (Eval): cost calc: hosted unit cost estimate per 1k input+output tokens — fp16: $0.012, int8: $0.0046 => 62% cost reduction.

Lee (Infra): logs from canary infra: 
```
2024-06-10T21:42:11Z canary-mistral9p-int8: batchsize=4, seq=1024, kv_cache=true
2024-06-10T21:42:12Z kernel=fast-attn-v2, prefetched=true
2024-06-10T21:42:12Z quant-mode=int8, perchannel=true
```
Not seeing OOMs or perf regressions beyond expected.

Jay (Product): how user-visible is the quality drop? Is it mostly under long-context few-shot summaries or general?

Ravi (Eval): it's concentrated on long-context abstractive summarization and heavy-rewrite prompts where the model previously used subtle token-level reasoning. Short Q/A and chat flows are fine. Examples included in the eval harness show hallucination rate up ~1.8x on that slice.

Carmen (ML Eng): hypothesis list: 1) int8 rounding + softmax sensitivity on long-range attention weights, 2) KV-cache quant propagation error accumulating on long seqs, 3) quantized layernorm / RMS norm numerical drift.

Lee (Infra): another possible: our int8 kernel falls back to a different attention kernel at seq>512 (we saw a fallback to slow path in some traces), which may change ordering/precision. I can dump kernel selection trace for failing requests.

Ravi (Eval): repro snippet I ran locally: 
```bash
python eval.py --model mistral-9p --quant int8 --slice long_summarize --batch 1 --seed 42 --save_preds preds.json
```
sample failing prompt id=342: expected high-fidelity condensation, got terse, lost entity linking.

Carmen (ML Eng): suggested experiments (short): 
- run int8 with per-tensor vs per-channel quant (compare)
- run int8 but keep fp16 for layernorm/ffn (mixed quant profile)
- run seq-length gated canary: route requests seq<=512 -> int8, >512 -> fp16
- run microbench: disable kv-cache to see if accumulation is KV related

Jay (Product): for GTN: what is the revenue impact if we keep fp16 for long-summarize? We have ~18% of traffic in that slice but it's high-value (document summarization feature).

Ravi (Eval): rough unit-econ: suppose 100M tokens/mo for summarization slice. Switching full traffic to int8 saves ~($0.012-$0.0046)*100k = around $740 for each 1M tokens; scale that up: for 100M tokens it's ~$74k/mo. If we hybrid route long-summarize to fp16 (18% traffic), monthly saving becomes (~82% * full-savings) ~ $60.6k/mo. Loss in quality could hit NPS or conversions — need product to weigh.

Carmen (ML Eng): ops plan proposal: 
1) short term (canary): enable seq-gated routing, keep current int8 canary but route seq>512 to fp16. Run 1M requests in canary window and compare delta.
2) mid term (2 weeks): run per-channel quant and layernorm-exempt int8 builds, evaluate slices.
3) long term: if int8 cannot match long-summarize quality, ship hybrid routing with autoscaling and fallback.

Lee (Infra): I can wire the seq-gate as a traffic-policy flag; need a model build tag for "int8-lnr-exempt" if you want layernorm in fp16.

Ravi (Eval): I will add focused eval hooks: A/B slice metrics (ROUGE, hallucination-rate, token-level divergence), add human spot-checks for 200 random failures.

Carmen (ML Eng): small triage test I already ran: keeping layernorm in fp16 recovers ~60% of the delta on that slice (ROUGE-L improved from 0.568 -> 0.597). So mixed-precision looks promising.

Jay (Product): good — that means we can likely keep most cost wins and protect critical long-doc users. timeline?

Carmen (ML Eng): timeline: seq-gated canary by EOD tomorrow, run 48h window. Mixed-precision build + eval in 3 working days. After positive results, roll to 50% traffic week after.

oncall-bot: Deploy queued: deployment m-9p-int8-gate will start in 30 minutes, tracked: #deploy-9876.

Lee (Infra): deploying gate now. Will post kernel trace sample for any failing request id.

Ravi (Eval): action items: I will create an eval card in the GTN board, attach the failure examples, and run the human spot-check.

Carmen (ML Eng): decision summary: do seq-gated hybrid canary, test mixed-precision (layernorm fp16), measure unit-econ impact vs product KPIs. If mixed-precision recovers >80% of quality delta we consider full int8 with hybrid routing for long docs.

Jay (Product): thanks — I'll brief GTN and surface potential revenue numbers if we need to keep fp16 for long-doc customers. :pray:

Carmen (ML Eng): thanks everyone, I'll update the canary tracker and ping once 6h of traffic collected. :rocket:
